{'text': '總統Donald Trump週五突然撤回針對俄羅斯經濟嘅大規模制裁措施，引發民主黨同共和黨議員嘅強烈不滿，包括內布拉斯加州共和黨眾議員Don Bacon，佢喺X平台上直言特朗普嘅施政議程已經「玩完」。', 'paragraph_context': 'President Donald Trump on Friday reversed course on sweeping sanctions targeting Russia’s economy, sparking outrage from both Democratic and Republican lawmakers, including Rep. Don Bacon (R-Neb.), who stated plainly on X that Trump’s agenda is now "dead."'}

{'text': '呢位內布拉斯加州共和黨人仲話：「總統有自己嘅議程：補充撥款、預算協調、宴會廳等等……我認為呢個議程已經玩完。我哋好多人都唔會再為呢啲嘢撥款，因為我哋知道佢喺度撐一個獨裁者嘅入侵，將盟友出賣。」', 'paragraph_context': 'The Nebraska Republican continued, "The President has an agenda: supplemental, reconciliation, Ballroom, etc… I think the agenda is dead. Many of us won\'t fund these things knowing he is propping up a dictator\'s invasion and throwing an ally under the bus."'}

{'text': '特朗普喺上個月先至簽署咗一項以已故南卡羅來納州共和黨參議員Lindsey Graham命名嘅法案，法案目的係要堵截資助俄羅斯對烏克蘭持續戰事嘅資金來源，但佢週五又簽署行政命令，正式叫停相關制裁。', 'paragraph_context': "Trump signed legislation just last month named after late Sen. Lindsey Graham (R-S.C.) that sought to suffocate the flow of financial resources fueling Russia's ongoing war on Ukraine, but signed an executive order Friday officially putting those sanctions on hold."}

{'text': '特朗普上週宣布美國同意向俄羅斯購買數以百萬噸計嘅柴油，試圖壓低因為佢對伊朗開戰而進一步推高嘅全球燃料價格——儘管此舉可能損害烏克蘭對俄羅斯嘅戰事。', 'paragraph_context': 'Trump had announced last week that the U.S. agreed to purchase millions of metric tons of diesel from Russia, in an attempt to lower global fuel prices that have been exacerbated by his war on Iran — despite this potentially hurting Ukraine in its war with Russia.'}

{'text': '特朗普撤回嘅制裁法案本來針對俄羅斯官員、銀行，以及維持俄羅斯能源流通嘅影子船隊油輪。法案亦要求特朗普對購買俄羅斯石油或天然氣最多嘅五大進口國徵收高達100%嘅關稅。', 'paragraph_context': 'The sanctions package reversed by Trump would have targeted Russian officials, banks and a shadow fleet of oil tankers keeping Russian energy moving. It also would have directed Trump to impose tariffs of up to 100% on the top five importers of Russian oil or natural gas.'}

{'text': '佢喺週六作出回應，事緣CNN主持Kate Bolduan轉發咗北卡羅來納州共和黨參議員Thom Tillis嘅社交媒體帖文，Tillis話佢對特朗普「向一個非法入侵烏克蘭、每日屠殺無辜平民嘅俄羅斯獨裁者投降」感到「令人震驚」。', 'paragraph_context': 'He reacted Saturday after CNN host Kate Bolduan reshared a social media post from Sen. Thom Tillis (R-N.C.), who said it\'s "unconscionable" that Trump is "capitulating to a Russian dictator who illegally invaded Ukraine and butchers innocent civilians every single day."'}

{'text': 'Tillis認為特朗普可以透過「解決伊朗問題」嚟壓低能源價格，而唔係「幫[俄羅斯總統]Vladimir普京一個忙」。Bolduan喺帖文入面讚揚Tillis「毫無保留」，並指出德州共和黨參議員John Cornyn亦表達過類似嘅憤慨。', 'paragraph_context': 'Tillis argued that Trump can fight energy prices "by solving the Iran problem, not by doing a solid for [Russian President] Vladimir Putin." Bolduan praised Tillis in her post for not "holding back," noting Sen. John Cornyn (R-Texas) has shared similar outrage.'}

{'text': 'Bacon喺即將舉行嘅中期選舉唔再角逐連任，呢一點或者可以解釋佢點解會就制裁逆轉同特朗普公開決裂。Cornyn同樣係即將卸任嘅共和黨議員，佢先前亦曾預言共和黨喺中期選舉會遭到災難性嘅敗績。', 'paragraph_context': "Bacon notably isn't running for re-election in the upcoming midterms, which could explain his open break with Trump over the sanctions reversal. Cornyn is similarly an outgoing GOP lawmaker, and has previously predicted catastrophic midterm results for Republicans."}
